tasks.subject: Task 1: Database migration and storage bucket
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `image_url` to the `component` table and provision the `component-images` Supabase Storage bucket with RLS policies.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/component_images.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `component` table has a nullable `image_url text` column
- [ ] `component-images` bucket exists and is public
- [ ] Any authenticated tenant member can INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to paths starting with their tenant ID
- [ ] Public reads work without auth headers

**Verify:** Check Supabase Studio for column and bucket.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/component_images.sql"], "verifyCommand": "Check Supabase Studio", "acceptanceCriteria": ["image_url column on component table", "component-images bucket is public", "RLS policies for tenant-scoped write"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Nexar API client
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Server-only module with OAuth2 token cache and `searchComponentImage(q)` GraphQL helper.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/nexar/client.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/nexar/client.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Returns `{ found: true, imageUrl, mpn, manufacturer }` when Nexar has results
- [ ] Returns `{ found: false, reason: "no_results" }` on empty results
- [ ] Returns `{ found: false, reason: "api_error" }` on HTTP failure
- [ ] All 3 Vitest tests pass

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/lib/nexar/client.test.ts` → 3 tests passing

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/nexar/client.ts", "src/lib/nexar/client.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/nexar/client.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["searchComponentImage returns found:true with imageUrl", "returns found:false/no_results on empty", "returns found:false/api_error on HTTP failure"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Component image server actions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Three server actions in `actions.ts` — upload, Nexar fetch, remove.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/actions.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `uploadComponentImage` validates type/size, uploads to storage, updates `component.image_url`, logs activity
- [ ] `fetchComponentImageFromNexar` queries preferred supplier part number, downloads + stores image
- [ ] `removeComponentImage` deletes from storage, clears `image_url`
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/actions.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["uploadComponentImage validates and uploads", "fetchComponentImageFromNexar fetches and stores", "removeComponentImage clears image_url"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: ComponentImage client component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Self-contained `"use client"` component with image slot, upload, find, remove, inline error state.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/component-image.tsx`
- Create: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/component-image.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 96×96 image shows when `initialImageUrl` set; grey placeholder + camera SVG when not
- [ ] Upload button triggers file picker; client-side validates type and size
- [ ] Find image button shown only when `hasSupplierPartNumber && !imageUrl`
- [ ] Remove button shown only when `imageUrl` is set
- [ ] All buttons disabled during `isPending`
- [ ] Inline error message shown on failure

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/[componentId]/component-image.tsx", "src/app/app/components/[componentId]/component-image.module.css"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["image displays at 96x96", "upload validates client-side", "find button conditional on hasSupplierPartNumber", "remove button conditional on imageUrl"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Wire into component detail page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `image_url` to data fetch, compute `hasPreferredPartNumber`, render `<ComponentImage>` in info card.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `image_url` selected in Supabase query and typed in `ComponentRecord`
- [ ] `hasPreferredPartNumber` computed from existing supplier catalog fetch
- [ ] `<ComponentImage>` renders above component name in `aside.infoCard`
- [ ] No TypeScript errors; app starts cleanly

**Verify:** `npm run dev` → navigate to a component detail page → image slot visible.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.tsx", "src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.module.css"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev — navigate to a component detail page", "acceptanceCriteria": ["image_url in ComponentRecord type and Supabase select", "hasPreferredPartNumber computed", "ComponentImage renders in info card"]}
```
